plugin.name: Host Auth Badges
plugin.description: Compact configurable SSH authentication source and method badges for the host list.

enabled.label: Show authentication badges
enabled.description: Hide all badges without disabling the plugin.

position.label: Position
position.description: Before or after the host name; Host Icons stays first when both are before the name.

iconSize.label: Icon size (%)
iconSize.description: Base icon size from 60 to 260%, independent from text.

compositionOverride.label: Host Auth Badges appearance
compositionOverride.description: Visual appearance for this host or inherited defaults.

sourceOverride.label: Source appearance override
sourceOverride.description: Stored source appearance; edited in the unified Host Auth Badges panel.

methodOverride.label: Method appearance override
methodOverride.description: Stored method appearance; edited in the unified Host Auth Badges panel.

ui.title: HOST AUTH BADGES
ui.label: Label
ui.hint: Termix Save applies the changes. Folder and host settings continue to inherit normally.
ui.monoHint: Monochrome ignores custom colors. Switch to another palette to edit accents.
ui.intro: See how SSH login is configured without opening each host. Badges do not test the connection or reveal secrets.
ui.unsavedHelp: Changes are temporarily applied to host badges. Press Save in Termix to keep them.
ui.hostSaveNote: Host and folder changes apply to real hosts after Termix Save.
ui.inheritLimit: Effective values shown below. Termix does not expose whether they were set here or inherited from a parent.
ui.inheritEffectiveInfo: Effective value; exact origin is not provided to plugins.
ui.inheritSingleHint: Request that Termix clears this value at the current level. Save in Termix to apply.
ui.inheritParentUnknown: A parent folder or server may supply different values; this is only your personal baseline, not a guarantee of the resulting inheritance.
ui.inheritConfirmDescription: The following effective appearance groups may include inherited values. This requests that the current level stops overriding them. No SSH connection settings or credentials are changed.
ui.inheritAfterSave: Press the normal Termix Save button. The final inherited values are recalculated by Termix and may differ from your user preferences.
ui.methodOnlyWarning: Current appearance hides SOURCE and METHOD text, leaving only a method icon. Use Customize Source and Method or Reset appearance to restore the labels.
